sentences.en: In the afternoon, I'm going to the cinema to watch a movie with my friend.
Traffic on the way was slow, I got anxious, and by the time I ran to the cinema I was already late.
I say to my friend: "Sorry, I'm late."
My friend smiles and says: "It's okay, the movie hasn't started yet."
Afterward, at school I forgot to bring my classmate's book.
My classmate said, "It's nothing — just bring it tomorrow." I said, "Thank you."

quiz.q: Why is the narrator late to the cinema?
a: Traffic was slow on the way

quiz.q: What did the narrator forget to bring to school?

grammar.e: 没关系 is the standard reply when someone apologizes to you.
grammar.x: 朋友说：“没关系，电影还没开始。”— Friend says: "It's okay, the movie hasn't started yet."

grammar.e: 没事 is a more casual reply to an apology, common between friends and classmates.
grammar.x: 同学说：“没事，你明天带来就可以了。”— Classmate says: "It's fine, you can just bring it tomorrow."

grammar.p: 跑到 + place + 的时候（by the time you arrive）
grammar.e: 到...的时候 marks the moment of arriving somewhere, showing what had already happened by then.
grammar.x: 跑到电影院的时候已经晚了。— By the time I ran to the cinema, I was already late.
